Widget family: SCROLLBAR

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A track along one edge (vertical or horizontal as claimed) is visible.
2. A distinct thumb/knob shorter than the track is visible on that track.
3. Thumb position roughly matches the claimed scroll fraction (start / middle / end).
4. FAIL if: no thumb, thumb spans the entire track (looks like a solid bar only), or scrollbar is missing while content is claimed to overflow.
